_doc: Eden Cosmetics · the controlled visual system: at most five generated concepts, each with a job, its placements, and hard limits. Rules in .claude/skills/ailgen-studio/references/12-visual-production.md. Products are never generated: product imagery is the store's own photos (cutouts keep their pixels, scripts/cutout.py). Generated plates carry no products, logos, text, faces or results. Run: node .claude/skills/ailgen-studio/scripts/imagegen.mjs --project projects/edencosmetic --concept <id>
house: Warm, calm, precise; an atelier for lash and brow professionals. Cream, blush and dusty rose; soft window light from the upper right; natural stone and satin; generous negative space. Editorial beauty still life, never glossy advertising, never clinical.
never: products, bottles, tubes, jars, boxes, packaging or labels
text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or brand marks
faces, eyes, lashes or brows; before-and-after or treatment results
stock clichés: flowers scattered on marble, fanned makeup brushes, spa stones, candles, champagne, gold glitter

routing._why: Vendor-neutral (references/12-visual-production.md, 'Choosing a model'). Drafts on Cloudflare's free daily allocation (FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, Apache 2.0). Finals through one fal.ai key: Nano Banana Pro for photographic light and material, FLUX.2 [pro] for colour-exact fields and wide textures (priced per megapixel, takes reference images), Seedream 4.5 as a third opinion. Gemini and OpenAI stay as fallbacks with their own keys. Video only from an approved still: Veo 3.1 Fast for drafts, Veo 3.1 for the final, Kling 3.0 Pro as the second opinion on motion. With only the Cloudflare token, finals fall back to FLUX.2 [dev] on the free daily allocation (about two 1-megapixel images a day), and the bake-off adds FLUX.2 [dev] and [klein] 9B, both free (checked 2026-10-01).

concepts.name: סדנת האור · The atelier surface
concepts.job: The stage for real products: the hero flat lay, the kit summary, share cards. Makes the products feel placed in Eden's studio without inventing a studio.

placements.where: home hero stage (behind the product cutouts)
placements.treatment: photo plate under real cutouts; video V2 on desktop

placements.where: share cards (og) behind a product cutout

concepts.prompt: Top-down editorial photograph of an empty warm travertine stone surface in blush-cream tones, from #F4E9E2 to #DFC7BA. Late-afternoon window light from the upper right casts long, soft diagonal shadows of window mullions and the blurred silhouette of a lotus leaf and petals across the lower left third. Fine natural stone pores, a faint linen texture at one edge, a gentle tonal gradient. Medium-format still-life photography, overhead, 50mm, f/8, soft and even. The surface is completely empty. The centre stays open and calm, ready for objects to be placed later.
concepts.avoid: objects, products, bottles, tubes, jars, boxes, tools, flowers, petals on the surface, people, hands, text, logos, watermark, glitter, marble veins, heavy vignette

video.prompt: Locked-off overhead camera over the same empty stone surface. The window light drifts very slowly across it and the soft lotus-leaf shadow sways gently, as in a light breeze. Nothing enters the frame. Calm, continuous, no cuts.
video.use: desktop hero plate, muted, plays when visible, poster on mobile and with reduced motion

route.why: the hero surface is about light on satin and stone: the most photographic model wins it; FLUX.2 [pro] is the bake-off rival

concepts.name: העיקול · The curl
concepts.job: The brand's signature in photography: a straight line that lifts into a curl, the lash after a lift and the tail of the E in the logo. Opens the kit builder band and the film.

placements.where: band between the kit builder and the brand shelf

concepts.prompt: Macro studio photograph of a single narrow ribbon of dusty-rose silk satin, #BF7F7F to #964F58, lying straight across a cream background (#F8EFEA); toward one end it lifts into a soft, elegant upward curl, like an eyelash after a lift. Soft diffused light, a gentle sheen along the satin, extremely shallow depth of field, creamy background blur. Minimal and sculptural, with wide negative space on both sides.
concepts.avoid: eyes, eyelashes, faces, text, logos, several ribbons, bows, knots, gift wrapping, glitter, jewellery

video.prompt: The satin ribbon lies straight, then slowly lifts at one end into a soft curl and holds there. Static camera, slow and graceful, one continuous motion, no cuts.
video.use: the band, muted, plays once when it enters the view, then rests on the curl

route.why: a wide abstract texture at 21:9: FLUX.2 [pro] is priced per megapixel and holds a strict palette

concepts.name: המקצוע · The craft
concepts.job: Shows the profession behind the store for the courses section: precise, calm hands at work. It is atmosphere, not a claim about Eden's studio, and it says so.
concepts.prompt: Close-up editorial photograph of a beauty professional's hands in blush-pink nitrile gloves arranging plain, unbranded lash-lift tools on a warm cream travertine tray: simple stainless steel tweezers, a slim lift rod, a few translucent silicone shields. Soft window light from the upper right, shallow depth of field, calm and precise. Cropped at the wrists.
concepts.avoid: faces, eyes, lashes being treated, a client, brand names, text, logos, packaging, bottles, tubes, jars, jewellery, long nails, messy surface
concepts.label: תמונת אווירה

route.why: gloved hands at work read as documentary: a real photo from Eden replaces it; generated only as the labelled fallback

concepts.name: שדות המותג · Brand fields
concepts.job: Gives each brand its own world on its page and its shelf panel, from the colours of its real packaging (brands.json look), without touching its identity: no logos, no packaging, no claims.

placements.where: brand page hero, behind the real product cutout

perBrand.thuya: glossy red lacquer plane (#C10C08) meeting matte charcoal paper (#1F1A1C) at a soft angle, a thin brushed-silver edge between them
perBrand.my-lamination: layered matte white and pale grey paper forms with soft, clinical shadows, calm and exact
perBrand.refectocil: deep brown and ink-navy velvet folds in warm side light, classic and quiet
perBrand.zola: translucent hot-pink and coral gel drops on a soft pink ground, playful and glossy
perBrand.nikk-mole: bold magenta and black paper planes with crisp, graphic shadows
perBrand.kodi: brushed grey metal meeting soft grey paper, cool and precise
perBrand.staleks: brushed stainless steel with a soft baby-pink reflection

concepts.prompt: Abstract studio photograph, a material study: {brand}. Soft studio light, shallow depth, generous empty space on one side for a product to be placed later.
concepts.avoid: text, logos, letters, packaging, products, bottles, tubes, jars, boxes, people, hands, faces

route.why: seven brand fields must match measured packaging colours: FLUX.2 [pro] with a colour-swatch reference (visual/refs/field-<brand>.png)

concepts.name: הלוטוס · The lotus at dawn
concepts.job: The origin of the logo's lotus and of Lotti: a quiet image for Eden's story, Lotti's introduction and the 404 page.

placements.where: behind the Eden section, very soft

concepts.prompt: Soft-focus fine-art photograph of a single pale blush lotus flower floating on still water at dawn, light mist, warm cream light, muted palette of #F8EFEA, #F0D3C3 and #BF7F7F, the flower small in the lower third with calm open space above.
concepts.avoid: several flowers, frogs, people, text, logos, saturated pink, dark water, lily pads covering the frame

route.why: a soft botanical texture for the About background: Seedream 4.5 is strong on delicate organic detail and costs $0.04

disclosure: חלק מתמונות האווירה באתר נוצרו בעזרת בינה מלאכותית. תמונות המוצרים הן הצילומים של המוצרים עצמם.

neverWhy.products: product imagery is only the store's own photos; a generated product would invent packaging, labels and claims
neverWhy.text: generated letters are wrong or invented; all words on the site are set in type
neverWhy.people: a generated face can pass as Eden, a client or a student; results must be real photos of real work
neverWhy.cliches: they make any beauty site look like every other one

grade._why: Every approved plate is graded toward the concept palette on publish (scripts/grade.py): a gentle Lab statistics transfer, reported as ΔE to the palette before and after. Never applied to products or to anything with product pixels.
